name: Upside-Down Beef "Cottage Pie" with Spinach, Peas & Sweet Potato Mash

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Place in a large pot, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the liquid in the pot is boiling, reduce heat to medium, cover, and simmer until sweet potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion and salt; cook, stirring occasionally until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the onion is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery.
Once the onion is soft, add the carrot and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3-4 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, peel and mince garlic.
Add garlic, beef, and spices to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until the beef is browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the sweet potatoes are done, drain and return to the pot. Add oil and spices; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add peas and vinegar to the skillet. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups frozen peas
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine, and continue to cook until peas are warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide sweet potato mash between plates or bowls; top with beef-veggie filling. Enjoy!
